Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = termid),
		isAttached: Boolean = CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(obs)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = isAttached
}
